import json, os, pathlib, sys, tempfile
sys.path.insert(0, "scripts")
import ledger as L
from observe_output import observe
live = next((p for p in (os.environ.get("PURRFECT_LIVE_ROOT"), ".", str(pathlib.Path.home() / "dev/purrfect-harness")) if p and pathlib.Path(p, ".tasks/smoke/f007c/repo").is_dir()), ".")
clone = pathlib.Path(live, ".tasks/smoke/f007c/repo")
txt = pathlib.Path(live, ".tasks/f007-smoke3.out").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
try:
    summary = json.loads(txt)
except ValueError:
    summary = [json.loads(line) for line in txt.splitlines() if line.startswith("{")][-1]
seats = ("claude.economy", "codex.economy", "cursor.economy", "cursor.premium")
ids = [summary["seats"][s]["run_id"] for s in seats]
schema = json.loads(pathlib.Path("schemas/ledger-row.schema.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
rec = {}
for seat, rid in zip(seats, ids):
    r = json.loads((clone / ".tasks/receipts" / (rid + ".json")).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    assert (r["run_id"], r["role"], r["mission"], r["outcome"]) == (rid, "worker", "docs/missions/00000000-f007-smoke", "completed"), (seat, r["outcome"])
    assert ("T-SMOKE-" + seat.replace(".", "-")) in json.dumps([r.get("work_unit"), r.get("task")]), (seat, r.get("work_unit"))
    om = r["observation"]["observed_model"]
    if r["provider"] in ("cursor", "agent"):
        assert om["source"] in ("observed", "unknown"), (seat, om)
    else:
        assert om["source"] == "observed" and om["value"] not in (None, "", "unknown"), (seat, om)
    rec[seat] = r
    row = json.loads((clone / ".tasks/ledger" / (rid + ".json")).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    L.validate_row(row)
    assert row["run_id"] == rid and row["schema_version"] == schema["properties"]["schema_version"]["const"], seat
    assert set(schema["required"]) <= set(row) <= set(schema["properties"]), (seat, sorted(set(row) ^ set(schema["properties"])))
assert [rec[s]["provider"] for s in seats[:2]] == ["claude", "codex"] and {rec[s]["provider"] for s in seats[2:]} <= {"cursor", "agent"}
assert "haiku" in rec["claude.economy"]["observation"]["observed_model"]["value"]
c = rec["codex.economy"]
log = pathlib.Path(c["log_path"])
raw = (log if log.is_absolute() else clone / log).read_bytes()
os.environ.pop("CODEX_SESSIONS_DIR", None)
assert observe("codex", raw)["observed_model"] == c["observation"]["observed_model"], "codex model is not the session-record model"
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as empty:
    os.environ["CODEX_SESSIONS_DIR"] = empty
    assert observe("codex", raw)["observed_model"]["source"] == "unknown", "codex stream alone names no model"
print("ok")

import json, os, pathlib, subprocess, uuid
live = next((p for p in (os.environ.get("PURRFECT_LIVE_ROOT"), ".", str(pathlib.Path.home() / "dev/purrfect-harness")) if p and pathlib.Path(p, ".tasks/smoke/f007c/repo").is_dir()), ".")
clone = pathlib.Path(live, ".tasks/smoke/f007c/repo")
txt = pathlib.Path(live, ".tasks/f007-smoke3.out").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
try:
    summary = json.loads(txt)
except ValueError:
    summary = [json.loads(line) for line in txt.splitlines() if line.startswith("{")][-1]
seats = ("claude.economy", "codex.economy", "cursor.economy", "cursor.premium")
ids = [summary["seats"][s]["run_id"] for s in seats]
assert summary["reconstruct_exit"] == 0, summary["reconstruct_exit"]
env = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if k != "PURRFECT_LIVE_ROOT"}
env["PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE"] = "1"
m = "docs/missions/00000000-f007-smoke"
r = subprocess.run(["bash", "scripts/reconstruct-run.sh", m, *ids], cwd=clone, env=env, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=300)
assert r.returncode == 0 and "MISSING" not in r.stdout and "INVALID" not in r.stdout, (r.returncode, r.stdout[-800:], r.stderr[-400:])
blocks = r.stdout.split("RUN ")[1:]
assert [blk.splitlines()[0].strip() for blk in blocks] == ids, r.stdout[:400]
for blk in blocks:
    for tok in ("  seat: ", "  spec: ", " sha256=", "  receipt: completed exit=0 ", "  observed model: ", "  VerificationRecord ", ": pass sha256=", "  ledger: ", " VALID"):
        assert tok in blk, (tok, blk[:300])
ghost = str(uuid.uuid4())
g = subprocess.run(["bash", "scripts/reconstruct-run.sh", m, ghost], cwd=clone, env=env, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120)
gone = {line.split(": ", 1)[1] for line in g.stdout.splitlines() if line.startswith("MISSING " + ghost + ": ")}
assert g.returncode == 1 and gone == {"spec", "receipt", "VerificationRecord", "ledger row"}, (g.returncode, gone)
print("ok")
